effects.display_name: Blood arrow native hit statuses and live ranged delivery
effects.actual_behavior: Native Blood onHitEntity first calls AbstractArrow.onHitEntity, then passes hit entity and current getOwner to its helper without a hurt-result check. Both arguments must be nonnull and recipient Living. Server Living recipient receives Wither80/1 and Darkness10/native amp1, false,true; server Living OWNER independently receives Regeneration60/1,true,false. If owner Living currently Strength, recipient igniteForSeconds4 runs without server/hurt-success guard. These extra requests therefore survive a failed superclass damage attempt; native collision admission remains inherited. Damage is inherited native ARROW, direct projectile plus native owner, not a custom Blood DamageType. Two live native callers, SpiderMothLarvae and SpiderMothSummonLarvae performRangedAttack, call shoot(this,target). That concrete helper constructs with Living shooter (native owner), null weapon; aims at targetY+eyeHeight-1.1, vertical trajectory offset hypot(dx,dz)*0.20000000298023224, shoot velocity3/inaccuracy12, baseDamage2.5, knockback3, silenttrue, criticalfalse and addFreshEntity. flval is unused. Parent damage remains speed/baseDamage based with native defenses; no additional direct damage is invented. Successful native hurt invokes this class doKnockback: positive stored level gives normalized motionXZ *level*.6*max(0,1-recipientKBResistance), then if lengthSquared>0 additive pushY.1. Native successful post-hurt decrements stuck-arrow count (presentation only). tick calls native super first, then discards when inGround, with no extra side/removed check. Other anonymous weapon/actor delivery subclasses and their overrides remain their own finite contexts; this contract does not assume they use this concrete helper or positive base knockback.

effects.display_name: Webbed arrow native owner baseline and victim progression
effects.actual_behavior: Webbed onHitEntity first calls AbstractArrow, then helper with HIT RECIPIENT, without reading hurt return. Helper only admits when recipient current health (nonLiving fallback-1) < recipient persistent momenthealth, and clears that key0 BEFORE effect branch. No Webbed requests initial60/0; existing amplifier0->80/1,1->100/2,2->120/3,>=3->140/4, all server Living,false,false. Native exact amplifier gates and default lookups remain; negative unmatched amplifier has no added request. This is a raw health comparison, not proof that this arrow successfully damaged the victim. Native tick calls super, then flying helper at PROJECTILE XYZ but passes getOwner as helper entity, then inGround discard. Nonnull OWNER and any Entity inflate2 around projectile cause a loop; iterator is ignored. If OWNER momenthealth<=0, write OWNER current Living health (nonLiving-1). This does not initialize each nearby actor or hit victim. A victim with no prior positive baseline fails the normal Living health comparison; a victim who independently owns another flying Webbed arrow can have a baseline. Only these two exact key consumers/writers occur in finite census; no automatic per-victim baseline is invented. Particles are presentation. Existing global join cleanup independently queues1200; native intrinsic cleanup remains distinct. Generated static shoot helpers have no external census callers; real Snatcher anonymous delivery and knockback from the locked target-event contract are reused. Other native spawning/ownership routes are retained without generic owner progression or team filtering.
